reason: The candidate matched SR/OSR/SPL and produced only tiny NE/nDTW changes on n=6 held-out episodes. This is insufficient evidence for promotion.
claim: H3-clean shows that decider-gated scripted expert demonstrations produce a clean training corpus, but 10 demonstrations across the current route families do not yield measurable held-out transfer to harder unseen families.
policy_refinement: A mechanical non-regression pass is not enough for promotion when n is small. Promotion requires either meaningful metric improvement on held-out routes, or statistically/operationally justified non-inferiority with a stated reason to replace the incumbent. H3-clean provides neither.
next_direction: H4: route-family diversity via NavGen-style generation under measured map + ExecFix + decider + scripted experts, held-out families preserved
